title: General Terms and Conditions | EC Assets
description: The general terms and conditions that apply to EC Assets products and services.

blocks.html: This is a structural placeholder for the mockup. The final wording must come from EC Assets' legal counsel before publication.
These terms apply to every contract between EC Assets and its customers for the Blocked Account, health insurance brokerage, the Bank Account and related services.
These terms govern the use of the EC Assets platform and all products ordered through it.
A contract is formed when EC Assets confirms your application by email. Until then, your application is an offer.

EC Assets opens the Blocked Account with its partner bank, arranges insurance as a broker and provides the customer portal. The banking and insurance contracts themselves are concluded with the respective partner.
The fees for each product are shown before you order and in your customer portal. Fees are due as stated in the price list.
You must provide accurate information, keep your login details safe and inform us of changes to your visa or residence status.

blocks.text: 6. Refund in case of visa refusal

blocks.html: If your visa is refused, EC Assets refunds the deposit and the service fees on presentation of the refusal letter.
EC Assets is liable for intent and gross negligence and, in cases of simple negligence, only for the breach of essential contractual duties, limited to foreseeable damage.
Either party may terminate the contract in text form with the notice periods stated in the product description.
German law applies. The place of jurisdiction for merchants is Berlin. Should a provision be invalid, the remaining provisions remain in force.
